text:
Paul Cotter has thrown 64 hits in 19 games for Vancouver, which is the part of his game his coaches like talking about. Pass it to Bulis's Daniel Wagner noted that Justin Williams praised him for "making guys earn their ice out there", then added that the Flyers were earning their ice against him.

That is the tension. Cotter has 8 points (4 goals), but at five on five the Canucks have had only 30.8% of the expected goals with him on the ice, 12 points worse than without him, and Evolving-Hockey found the same pattern last season in New Jersey (bottom 8% of forwards at creating offense). His scoring is riding a 30.8% shooting rate on 13 shots, a number that will not last. He has gone pointless in eight of his last ten games and his ice time is down 2:18 a night over that stretch. He adds speed, a heavy shot and a 2023 Cup ring from Vegas. A long-term role in the top nine depends on the shot share moving.
headline: Paul Cotter's hits are louder than his offense
